summary.intent: Use the GSD Manager to orchestrate the v1.1 milestone's remaining hardening block, starting by discussing Phase 51 (Crypto-Signature & Secret-Leak Hardening) to capture implementation decisions before planning and execution.
summary.outcome: Manager dashboard initialized showing 35/40 phases complete with 5 hardening phases remaining (51–55); Phase 51 discuss workflow completed successfully, producing 51-CONTEXT.md and 51-DISCUSSION-LOG.md with four locked implementation decisions covering HARD-02 requirements.

repo: Phases 51–55 all depend only on Phase 49 (complete) and are fully independent hardening tracks — they can be worked in any order or in parallel.
HARD-02 scope covers three IPNS signed-record findings (S1 publish validation, S2 fail-closed verification, S3 key zeroization) plus web logger redaction wired to a Faro transport (#15).
S1 anti-rollback for embedded-vs-embedded 409 already shipped; only the embedded-vs-DTO variant is open work.
Faro beforeSend scrub list is locked: privateKey, rootFolderKey, folderKey, fileKey, accessToken — registerFaroTransport guarded on VITE_FARO_URL.
S3 scope was deliberately expanded to an exhaustive sweep (every SDK function + every Rust unwrap path + enforcement with lint/test guard) to prevent re-drift.
workflow: GSD dep parser breaks on parenthetical annotations in roadmap phase names — '(v1.1 baseline)' was split into deps [49, '1.1'], making all downstream phases appear blocked with deps_satisfied: false.
When deps_satisfied is false for all phases, recommended_actions returns empty, so the Continue action menu is blank even when phases are actually unblocked.
Phase active flags (is_active) can go stale in STATE.md even after a phase is marked complete in ROADMAP.md — the two sources can diverge.
The discuss-phase workflow's init phase-op call loads context files lazily; prior CONTEXT.md files from earlier phases carry forward locked decisions to avoid re-asking.

friction: GSD dep parser misread 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as two deps (49 and phantom '1.1'), causing all five hardening phases to show deps_satisfied: false and producing an empty recommended_actions list.
Phase 50 showed is_active: true and roadmap_complete: false despite being marked '[x] completed 2026-06-19' in ROADMAP — required manual override to proceed.
Because recommended_actions was empty, the manager's Continue button was absent; the user had to manually identify phases 51–55 as unblocked and select Phase 51 explicitly.
open_items: Phases 52–55 (Desktop FUSE Durability, Release & Supply-Chain, E2E Test-Infra Typing, Large Source-File Refactor) still need discuss → plan → execute.
Phase 51 planning and execution not yet started — CONTEXT.md written but no plan exists.
GSD dep parser bug with parenthetical annotations in roadmap phase names should be reported/fixed upstream.
Stale is_active flag on Phase 50 in STATE.md should be cleared to keep dashboard accurate.
S3 exhaustive key zeroization sweep across all SDK functions and Rust unwrap paths is a significant scope expansion — needs scoping during planning to estimate wave count.
